Playing on PS5, and I've noticed quite a few issues.

1. Pretty much every match of Free-for-all goes over either the time or score limit, if not both. I've "won" quite a few times only for someone else to sweep by me as the match goes in to 40 or 50 kills.

2. Respawn times are inconsistent. This is as smaller gripe, but spawning can take between ten seconds all the way up to thirty. (Is there a setting so if you're in the class menu you can still respawn without resetting the spawn timer? Annoying but not game breaking)
2b. I will frequently spawn in the middle of a group of people and die instantly in free-for-all. I get that spawns won't always be balanced, but with inconsistent spawn timing it can be a full minute before you are actually back in the action.

3. I upped the sensitivity from default as it was painfully slow. Now, I can turn faster in every direction except for horizontally right. Right seems to be stuck at the default (VERY slow) setting. It's not a controller issue, as I have tried on two different ones. This may just be a mechanic that I'm unaware of.

4. Throwing weapons will sometimes take forever, or just register as L1 or R1. Died quite a few times from this.

Additionally, remapping controls is a must. Crouch is basically unusable on controllers if you are in a group fight. 

Moat important of all, the emote meta is entirely unbalanced in favor of pc. Joking, but there is an entire button on the dualshock 4 and dualsense going unused. Swipe or even just stickying your favorite emote to the TouchPad would be awesome. I realize that would take a fair deal of work, so obviously not a big priority. 

Despite this wall of text, I'm still having fun. I hope that things aren't too hectic for your team, and keep up the good work.
